description: Active BRPs list is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. List of Balance Responsible Parties (BRPs) This publication is currently incomplete. Some data may be missing or unavailable. We are working to resolve the issue and update the dataset as soon as possible. Coverage: Belgium. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Contractual Information. The portal shows 2025-02-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
